EmailTemplate.subject: Welcome to Monster College - {!Account.Name}
EmailTemplate.textOnly:
Dear Mr/Ms,
Welcome to Monster College™ - a perfect platform for potential employers to connect with fresh graduates and college students across India. Monster College™ is backed by the brand Monster (www.monsterindia.com), a leading job portal with a database of 20,000 employers and 61.3 million cumulative resumes. Your account has been created and we are highly pleased to have you as a privileged member of the Monster College™. A copy of the Service Agreement executed is attached herewith for your ready reference and record. We request you to go through the Agreement to verify products/services subscribed and payment terms. With this association, we are confident to help you find the right talent for your hiring needs and showcase your employer brand effectively to the potential job seekers. We look forward to having a mutually beneficial relationship. If you have any queries, please feel free to reach out at operations@monstercollege.in Thanks & Regards, Monster College Team Phone: 01204024310 ( Available Monday to Friday from 10:30 Hrs. to 17:00 Hrs.) Email: operations@monstercollege.in Escalation of any Customer Service matter In the unlikely event of your query or complaint not being resolved promptly to your satisfaction, please write a mail to operations@monstercollege.in as a first level of escalation and to crhead@monstercollege.in for second level escalation. The matter will be directly investigated by the senior management of our Customer Service team. Terms of Use We thank you for using Monster. For uninterrupted access to our services, it is important for you to read and understand our Terms of Use
